facts.fact: Tech Africa News, citing ITU analysis, says the six CEMAC countries are developing the Central African Backbone to interconnect their national fibre networks, backed by about $273 million from member states and partners, and treats it as the framework for the Central African Republic; it gives no event date, so the article's published date of 2026-08-27 is used.

systems.owner: six CEMAC member states with development partners
